zh: 我从来不带现金。
en: I {never} carry cash.

zh: 今年房租大幅上涨。
en: Rents have gone up {sharply|dramatically|steeply|significantly|a lot|considerably} this year.

zh: 尽量把工资的至少百分之十存起来。
en: Try to save {at least} ten percent of your pay.

zh: 修车花了大约五百块。
en: It cost {roughly|about|around|approximately} five hundred dollars to fix the car.

zh: 我所有的银行业务都在网上办理。
en: I do all my banking {online}.

zh: 坦白讲，我们现在买不起新车。
en: {Frankly|Honestly|To be honest}, we can't afford a new car right now.

zh: 每月一号会自动扣款。
en: The payment goes out {automatically} on the first of each month.

zh: 我不小心把同一张账单付了两次。
en: I {accidentally|mistakenly} paid the same bill twice.

zh: 我刚发了工资，所以晚饭我请。
en: I've {just} been paid, so dinner's on me.

zh: 现在油价贵得离谱。
en: Petrol is {ridiculously|incredibly|insanely} expensive at the moment.

zh: 严格来说这是一笔贷款，但我父母并不指望我还。
en: {Technically|Strictly speaking}, it's a loan, but my parents don't expect me to pay it back.

zh: 我们四个人把账单平摊了。
en: We split the bill {evenly|equally} between the four of us.

zh: 她很明智地把积蓄拿去投资了。
en: She invested her savings {wisely|sensibly|carefully}.

zh: 银行想必会要求看收入证明。
en: The bank will {presumably|probably} want to see proof of income.

zh: 我终于还清了学生贷款。
en: I've {finally} paid off my student loan.

zh: 因为什么都涨价了，我们如今很少在外面吃了。
en: We eat out less {nowadays|these days|now} because everything costs more.

zh: 批量买更便宜。再说，还能少跑一趟商店。
en: It's cheaper to buy in bulk. {Besides|Also|Plus}, it saves a trip to the shops.

zh: 钱立刻就到我账户上了。
en: The money appeared in my account {immediately|instantly|straight away|right away}.

zh: 我觉得我在外卖上花得太多了。
en: I think I spend {too|way too|far too} much on takeaways.

zh: 我现在挣得更多了。然而，我并没有觉得更富裕。
en: I earn more now. {However|Still|Nevertheless|Even so}, I don't feel any richer.
